visual_review.identity: Deep cool charcoal-blue-gray rounded-polygon paving with broad smoother main faces and subdued medium joint infill. Less fractured and cleaner than forge-stone-1, no invented fire, metal, glow or water.
visual_review.detail_density: Approximately 4-6 dominant main stones across width, fewer/larger than proposed 8-12; many medium infill stones remain. Large faces use broad low-contrast gray planes with minimal cracks.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Main stones often span about 40-80 world units at the proposed 256-unit period. Preview scale is not final production acceptance and does not alter rules.
visual_review.style_caveat: This is the cleanest large-face paving of the quartet, though small joint stones and soft face mottling remain. Native pixels preserved without smoothing.
visual_review.native_acceptance: 1254 fully opaque native, smooth cool paving identity retained. Original tone 3 catalog-only, no scene binding or natural seamlessness claim.
visual_review.palette_caveat: The overall RGB mean is approximately 58.5/57.9/57.6, more neutral and very slightly warmer than the original 55.6/57.4/59.2. The original cool-blue cast has been weakened, not exactly matched.
